query.name: query
query.help: Code used to prefix a query (must end with an equals character).

safesearch.name: safesearch
safesearch.help: Safe search method. You can disable safe search, add the safe search string to URLs, or insert a safe search header.

options.name: disable
options.help: Site does not support safe search.

options.name: url
options.help: Safe search selected with a parameter in the URL.

options.name: header
options.help: Safe search selected by search header (i.e. youtube.edu).

options.name: translate
options.help: Perform URL FortiGuard check on translated URL.

options.name: yt-pattern
options.help: Pattern to match YouTube channel ID.

options.name: yt-video
options.help: Pattern to match YouTube video name.

options.name: yt-channel
options.help: Pattern to match YouTube channel name.

safesearch-str.name: safesearch-str
safesearch-str.help: Safe search parameter used in the URL in URL mode. In translate mode, it provides either the regex to translate the URL or the special case to translate the URL.
